Package domain.clustering

Class QualityMetricCalculator

java.lang.Object
domain.clustering.QualityMetricCalculator
public class QualityMetricCalculator extends Object
Calculadora de métricas de calidad para análisis de clustering. Proporciona cálculo de coeficiente de silueta y Davies-Bouldin.

  • Method Details

    • calculateSilhouette

      public Double calculateSilhouette(ClusteringAnalysis analysis, DistanceCalculator distance)
      Calculates the Silhouette Coefficient for a clustering analysis. The Silhouette Coefficient is a measure of how similar an object is to its own cluster (cohesion) compared to other clusters (separation).
      Parameters:
      analysis - The ClusteringAnalysis object containing clusters, responses, and questions.
      distance - The DistanceCalculator to use for distance computations.
      Returns:
      The average Silhouette Coefficient across all responses, or 0.0 if calculation is not possible.

    • calculateSilhouetteForCluster

      public Double calculateSilhouetteForCluster(Cluster cluster, ClusteringAnalysis analysis, DistanceCalculator distance)
      Calculates the Silhouette Coefficient for a single cluster.
      Parameters:
      cluster - The cluster for which to calculate the score.
      analysis - The ClusteringAnalysis object.
      distance - The DistanceCalculator.
      Returns:
      The average Silhouette score for the cluster.

    • calculateCalinskiHarabasz

      public Double calculateCalinskiHarabasz(ClusteringAnalysis analysis, DistanceCalculator distance)
      Calculates the Calinski-Harabasz Index for a clustering analysis. This index is a ratio of the between-cluster dispersion to the within-cluster dispersion. Higher values generally indicate better clustering.
      Parameters:
      analysis - The ClusteringAnalysis object.
      distance - The DistanceCalculator.
      Returns:
      The Calinski-Harabasz Index, or 0.0 if calculation is not possible.

    • calculateDaviesBouldin

      public Double calculateDaviesBouldin(ClusteringAnalysis analysis, DistanceCalculator distance)
      Calculates the Davies-Bouldin Index for a clustering analysis. This index is a ratio of within-cluster scatter to between-cluster separation. Lower values generally indicate better clustering.
      Parameters:
      analysis - The ClusteringAnalysis object.
      distance - The DistanceCalculator.
      Returns:
      The Davies-Bouldin Index, or 0.0 if calculation is not possible.

    • interpretScore

      public String interpretScore(QualityMetricType metricType, Double score)
      Provides a textual interpretation of a given quality score based on its type.
      Parameters:
      metricType - The type of quality metric.
      score - The calculated score.
      Returns:
      A string interpretation of the score.
